title: Crew Bars
summary: Bar charts of counts and proportions with geom_bar(), stacked, dodged and filled.
hints: First flights with decades: `astronauts |> filter(mission_number == 1) |> mutate(decade = floor(year_of_mission / 10) * 10)`.
`geom_bar()` counts rows for you: `ggplot(first_flights, aes(x = factor(decade), fill = sex)) + geom_bar()`. Add `position = "fill"` inside `geom_bar()` for proportions.
Counts per decade: `group_by(decade) |> summarise(flyers = n(), women = sum(sex == "female"))`.
